title: Pool, Hot Tub & Mini Golf! Brand New Luxury 5BR
description:
**JUST RENOVATED | Heated Pool & Hot Tub | Mini Putt | Game Room | Sleeps 16 | Near Scottsdale & ASU**

This spacious 5-bedroom, 3-bath home features a large private backyard with a heated Pebble Tec pool, hot tub, mini putt and Weber grill, a game room with pool table & shuffleboard, and room for everyone to relax comfortably. 

Convenient location just minutes from Tempe, Scottsdale, and ASU, with easy access to dining, golf, shopping, and major freeways.

 The space 
- Sleeps 16 guests comfortably
- Keyless entry & fast Wi-Fi
- Private 3-car garage + driveway parking
- Large dining areas seating up to 20

🌴 Outdoor Living

- Brand new hot tub*
- Heated Pebble Tec pool & hot tub*
- Mini putt 
- Spacious fenced backyard
- Weber BBQ grill
- Firepit & lounge chairs 

🎱 Entertainment

- Pool table
- Premium shuffleboard
 - Large family room for movies & games

🍽️ Kitchen & Dining

- Fully equipped kitchen
- Coffee maker & essentials
- Oversized dining tables for group meals

🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements

Main Level (no stairs):
- Bedroom 1: double bed + twin bunk
- Full bathroom with tub/shower

Upstairs:
- Primary Suite: King bed, ensuite bath with jacuzzi tub, walk-in shower & makeup station
- Bedroom 3: Queen bed
- Bedroom 4: Two twin bunks
- Bedroom 5: Two double beds
- Full hallway bathroom with double vanity

⭐ Extra Services (Optional)

- Pool & spa heating: $75/day (both) or $50/day (pool only or spa only). Advance notice required; temp set to 83–85°F. Heating applies to the entire stay. Ask about flat rates for longer stays

- Concierge services available: Pre-stocked groceries, housekeeping, décor, restaurant reservations & specialty packages (fees vary)

📌 Good to Know

- Weekly pool & landscaping service (brief backyard access required)
- Discounts available for weekly & monthly stays
- For stays over 28 days, bi-weekly cleaning is required

📜 House Rules (Important)

We want you to have an amazing stay while respecting our quiet neighborhood:

- Check-in after 4 PM | Check-out by 11 AM
- No smoking inside the home
- Quiet hours: 9 PM – 8 AM (city ordinance)
- No parties or unauthorized events

🚫 Violations may result in fines, eviction without refund, and additional charges.

Pet-friendly for cats & dogs with a $50/pet fee (no pets on furniture, beds, or in the pool).

Traveling with a larger group or need multiple homes?

We have additional luxury properties nearby, including:
- 6-bedroom / 3-bath with heated pool
- 7-bedroom / 4-bath with pool & spa

Message us for availability or monthly discounts.

 Guest access 
Guests will be contacted 24-96 hours before check-in with the door code and check-in instructions. If you do not receive instructions, please get in touch with us!

 Other things to note 
Short-Term Rental Registration Number: LIC24-10790

This property is fully licensed and compliant with local short-term rental regulations.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
HDTV with Netflix, Roku, standard cable
